suggestions.title: Fight Club
suggestions.description: A disillusioned office worker and a charismatic soap salesman form an underground fight club that spirals into something much larger. David Fincher's mind-bending masterpiece is a visceral, darkly funny takedown of consumerism and modern masculinity. Brad Pitt and Edward Norton deliver career-defining performances, leading to one of cinema's most unforgettable twists. The first rule of Movie Night Club: you talk about Movie Night Club.

suggestions.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
suggestions.description: Archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis to find the biblical Ark of the Covenant before it falls into their hands. Steven Spielberg and George Lucas created the gold standard of adventure cinema. Harrison Ford's Indy dodges booby traps, fights giant boulders, battles snakes, and outwits villains in a relentless thrill ride that defined a generation. The boulder chase alone is worth the price of admission.

suggestions.title: Amélie
suggestions.description: A shy waitress in Montmartre decides to secretly improve the lives of those around her while pursuing her own love story. Jean-Pierre Jeunet's visual masterpiece is pure cinematic joy — a whimsical, candy-colored Parisian fairy tale that reminds us that the smallest acts of kindness can change the world. Audrey Tautou is utterly radiant. The kind of film that leaves you smiling for days.
